criteria.description: Reads exactly N values and sums them with a 64-bit type (long long) so sums up to 100 x 1e9 do not overflow; handles negative values and N = 1.
Readable structure and naming, appropriate types, no unnecessary work; reads standard input and prints only the sum.

notes: W1. Must precede section assignment (students cannot submit while the 5.00 rubric allocation is undefined).
